Sign in to the hosted MORIE language model

Source: R/llm_native.R
bricklayer_llm_login.Rd

Mints a personal key for https://llm.rmorie.com and stores it in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/morie/credentials.json (owner-only; the file the morie and rmorie packages read too, so one sign-in serves all three). Three ways in:

  • token: a key you already have, from the website or an email; stored as is.

  • email: a 6-digit code is sent to the address (valid ten minutes, single use); you type it, or pass code.

  • neither: the GitHub device flow; a code is shown to enter at github.com, and the key arrives once you approve.

Nothing is written except by this explicit call.

Usage

bricklayer_llm_login(
  token = NULL,
  email = NULL,
  code = NULL,
  open_browser = interactive(),
  poll_max_seconds = 600
)

Arguments

token

A key from https://llm.rmorie.com.

email

Sign in with a code sent to this address.

code

The emailed code, when you already have it.

open_browser

Open the GitHub page for the device flow.

poll_max_seconds

How long the device flow waits for approval.

Value

The key, invisibly.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
bricklayer_llm_login(email = "you@example.com")
bricklayer_llm_login() # GitHub device flow
bricklayer_llm_login(token = "<key from https://llm.rmorie.com>")
} # }
